title: SSE Event Envelope
description: Server-Sent Events envelope streamed by GET /runs/{run_id}/stream as text/event-stream. Each event is serialized as 'data: <json>\n\n'. The stream ends with a run.finished event.

run_id.description: Identifier of the run this event belongs to.

seq.description: Monotonically increasing sequence number within the run, starting at 0.

type.description: The kind of event being emitted.

ts.description: ISO8601 timestamp of when the event was produced.

data.description: Type-specific payload. Shape depends on the value of 'type'.
